purpose: Bundled starter background plates for KinetiFrame
format: PNG; flattened artwork, not separately editable scene objects

scenes.name: Living room
scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: KinetiFrame starter animation background, version 1.
Primary request: Produce ONE complete landscape background plate, 16:9 composition, preferably 1536x864. Full bleed scene, not a collage or framed art.
Style: original polished simplified 2D cartoon background with rounded organic drawing, clean dark charcoal outlines thinner than foreground character outlines, restrained flat fills with subtle warm shading. Friendly educational/animatic tone, readable large shapes, not photorealistic, not a crude geometric placeholder. Moderate muted colours so inserted characters remain the focus.
Composition: eye-level, minimal perspective, useful flat staging area, generous empty character space, no foreground objects obstructing actors. Background alone, NO characters, NO text, no logo, no watermark, no UI, no labels, no decorative outside border.

Scene/backdrop: Warm cream living room, back wall with a broad window, muted teal sofa confined to one edge, a small plant at the opposite edge, simple wood floor. Wide central floor and wall left empty. No coffee table blocking characters.
